name: AI-Agents-SKILLS-for-Academic-Use
title_zh: 学术全流程技能包：从读文献到可视化输出
tagline_zh: 研究生赶论文最怕的不是写，是读不完文献、画不出图、练不了题。这套技能把学习、可视化。
tagline_en: Grad students fear endless reading, weak figures, no practice. This pack chains learning, visualization.
desc_en: A collection of new and reusable AI-agent skills for learning, visualisation, problem-based practice, and research (literature review), for Academic use.
why_zh: 不是零散脚本，而是按学术任务重组的可复用技能单元。每个技能都带清晰输入输出。
why_en: Not scattered scripts but task-shaped reusable skills. Each has clear I/O, drops into your own agent workflow, and skips the.
limit_zh: 只覆盖学习、可视化、问题式练习、文献综述四类场景；不含写作润色、投稿排版、实验设计。技能需自行适配本地模型或 API。
limit_en: Covers only learning, visualization, problem-based practice, and lit review. No writing polish, submission formatting, or experiment design.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Academic skill pack: literature to visualization
